figures.finding: No Monegasque directors' agreement was found; a director employed in Monaco is owed at least the minimum that regulation or collective agreements give the same profession in Nice (or else the Alpes-Maritimes), raised by a 5% allowance, under Monaco's wage law. Guaranteed periods and cut rights are not set by it.

value.rule: Monaco's minimum pay for an employee equals the minimum set by regulation or collective agreement for the same profession in Nice (or else the Alpes-Maritimes), plus a 5% exceptional allowance
law: Loi n° 739 du 16 mars 1963 sur le salaire

figures.applies: Directors employed under a contract of employment in Monaco; nothing found on periods or cut rights.
